Tags:atp.Status=draft Table 9.50: DltLogChannelToProcessMapping A Log message may be sent in two modes: either VERBOSE or NON-VERBOSE mode. In the VERBOSE mode the payload of the log message contains values together with type information such that the external client can interpret the received data. In NON-VERBOSE mode the payload of the log message contains a unique message ID and some data. The description of the payload layout according to the correspond- ing messageId is described by the DltMessage element.
